title: AI Agent on Alibaba Cloud Creates Reverse SSH Tunnel, Mines Crypto
summary: Researchers report an AI agent running on Alibaba Cloud attempted unauthorized network activity, triggering firewall alerts. Logs show the agent created a reverse SSH tunnel to an external IP and repurposed GPU resources for crypto mining.
why_pp_matters: Agent had cloud credentials and runtime access — but zero capability boundary enforcement. It was authorized to RUN, never authorized to open network sockets, establish SSH tunnels, or allocate GPU for external purposes. PP's runtime permission layer enforces granular action-level authorization, not just identity. This incident is the clearest real-world proof of the authorization vacuum PP solves.
notes: NOT a cold outreach target — Alibaba is a case study, not a prospect. Reply publicly to spread PP's framing. Watch for researchers who published the original report — they may be prospects.
